Source contracts: src/agent_runtime/tools.py

src/agent_runtime/tools.py

Python · Tier A

Define validated source-owned tool, skill and section contracts.

Responsibilities

  • Describe argument/result schemas, effects, prerequisites, executors, cancellation transport and section ownership. Source-owned resource classes supply scheduler demand metadata, including disk_read_heavy; they grant neither effect proof nor execution authority.

Boundaries

  • These definitions do not grant execution permission, validate remote effects or install an integration.

Lifecycle

  • Factories construct validated definitions; registry snapshots isolate schema dictionaries; the native catalog exposes permitted declarations.

State

  • Frozen models retain callable service references. snapshot deep-copies contract JSON without cloning executor dependencies.

Security

  • Canonical IDs reject reserved namespaces/separators; schema and section validation reject malformed contracts and cycles before registration.

Collaborators

  • capabilities/registry.py registers definitions; native/catalog.py projects entry/section discovery; execution/engine.py enforces runtime authority.

Public surface

  • ToolDefinition validates arguments and wraps executable adapters; SkillDefinition and SkillSectionDefinition describe ownership and optional large-skill discovery.

Symbol Line Documentation
object_schema 60 Build a complete argument schema for a concrete operation.
ToolDefinition 69 An adapter contract. Adapters own validation of successful output. result_schema describes result data for discovery, tooling and tests; the generic ExecutionEngine does not infer external-effect failure from a schema mismatch.
ToolDefinition.normalize_internal_domain 137 @brief Ensure an internal effect is classified in the internal state domain before contract validation.
ToolDefinition.runtime_availability 144 @brief Return a safe available/reason result from the adapter prerequisite check; missing executors and malformed/failed checks are unavailable.
ToolDefinition.valid_contract 167 @brief Reject reserved tool identities and invalid schemas, requiring object-shaped arguments before registration.
ToolDefinition.validate_arguments 192 @brief Require an argument object, apply configured strict schema validation and return a detached copy.
ToolDefinition.snapshot 205 Copy contract JSON without cloning the executor's service dependencies.
ToolDefinition.execute 216 @brief Invoke the registered executor and require an ExecutionResult; missing executors and invalid return types fail explicitly.
SkillSectionDefinition 227 Non-recursive discovery node; identifiers follow the vendor hierarchy.
SkillSelectionDefinition 242 Describe whether a skill participates in automatic selection, requires explicit choice or is available only as a dependency. The bounded summary is routing metadata, not permission.
SkillDefinition 251 Group owned and reused tools with discovery sections, guidance, prerequisites, configuration, resource descriptions and progress support. Registration validates ownership and progress; capability policy independently selects which tools an accepted run may expose.
SkillDefinition.valid_sections 283 @brief Validate section/tool ownership and a cycle-free single-parent hierarchy; reject missing references, duplicate assignments and cross-skill section IDs.
